title: B-tree careful shared-cache mutex ordering

scope.rationale: btreeLockCarefully is the deadlock-avoidance slow path for a failed nonblocking BtShared mutex acquisition: it releases locked later Btrees, acquires the requested mutex, then reacquires every later wanted mutex in ascending list order.
excluded_responsibilities: BtShared mutex allocation and connection ownership

external_source_responsibilities: Connection mutex is already held; pNext is sorted by BtShared address; mutex try/enter/leave operations are supplied by the active Btree owner
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete private slow path is assigned and is called by native VDBE Btree entry. The current bounded VDBE owner supplies a no-contention mutex seam; connection-backed BtShared mutex dispatch remains open.

inputs: Unlocked target Btree in an ascending same-connection pNext chain and typed try/lock/unlock operations
outputs: Target locked; every later Btree with nonzero wantToLock locked; later unwanted Btrees left unlocked
contracts.ownership: All Btree nodes, BtShared mutexes, and callback context are borrowed. No allocation or list mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: A successful try locks only the target and returns immediately. A failed try unlocks each locked later node before blocking on target, then reacquires wanted later nodes in list order.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds the connection mutex. Mutex callbacks run synchronously and may block only in the lock operation after larger-address locks have been released. No I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Mutex enter/leave callbacks are infallible under the source interface. List/lock consistency is asserted before mutation.

representation_differences: Opaque BtShared mutex access is represented by typed try/lock/unlock operations while Btree locked/wantToLock/pNext state remains source-layout data.
The source lock helper also assigns BtShared.db; that opaque owner update remains the callback provider's responsibility and is not yet represented by the bounded VDBE seam.

oracle.protocol: A native source-layout unit trace records callback order for successful try and failed try with one locked later node plus one unlocked wanted node; compare exact event order and every final locked flag. Pinned-C contended mutex trace remains pending.
oracle.normalization: BtShared pointer addresses are represented by explicit ascending linked-list order; callback event order and lock state are exact.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O. Real two-connection contention and process mutex integration remain pending.
assurance.malformed_input: Unsorted, unsharable, or locked-without-demand list states violate source assertions.
assurance.continuation: On return the target and all later wanted locks are held consistently for caller continuation.
assurance.performance: Fast path is one try operation; contended path is linear in later Btrees and preserves source lock ordering.

integration.native_call_path: enterBtrees increments wantToLock and calls btreeLockCarefully for an unlocked selected Btree. The bounded default seam succeeds without contention.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Real BtShared mutex dispatch and db publication remain open.

independent_review.notes: Requires real BtShared mutex integration, contended pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect operations to the configured BtShared mutex and publish BtShared.db.
Integrate source sqlite3BtreeEnter/Leave and EnterAll/LeaveAll owners.

callees: sqlite3_mutex_try performs the nonblocking fast path
